title: DuQUAD: A Dual-View Framework with Quality-Aware Evidence Pruning for Multi-Document Question Answering
abstract: arXiv:2610.37701v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models with retrieval-augmented generation systematically underutilize evidence in the middle of multi-document contexts, a phenomenon known as Lost in the Middle. Existing mitigation strategies, such as document reordering and attention steering, can reduce boundary bias but remain brittle in noisy settings, where inaccurate relevance estimation and spurious documents still obscure useful evidence in central positions. We propose DuQUAD, a multi-document QA framework that mitigates positional bias through dual-view reasoning and quality-aware evidence pruning. DuQUAD combines a Local Agent guided by a Structural Fusion Score with a Global Agent that reasons over the full document set, providing both targeted evidence recovery and broad contextual understanding. translated_title: DuQUAD：面向多文档问答的具有质量感知证据剪枝的双视角框架
translated_abstract: 带有检索增强生成的大语言模型系统性地未能充分利用多文档上下文中间部分的证据，这一现象被称为“迷失在中间”。现有的缓解策略，如文档重排序和注意力引导，虽然可以减少边界偏差，但在嘈杂环境下仍然脆弱，因为不准确的相关性估计和虚假文档仍会掩盖位于中心位置的有用证据。我们提出DuQUAD，一个通过双视角推理和质量感知证据剪枝来缓解位置偏差的多文档问答框架。DuQUAD将由结构融合分数引导的局部智能体与对整个文档集合进行推理的全局智能体相结合，既提供有针对性的证据恢复，又提供广泛的上下文理解。该框架进一步使用显式质量评分过滤候选证据，并在句子级别对其进行细化以减少噪声。DuQUAD持续优于（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: DuQUAD通过结合由结构融合分数引导的局部智能体与全局推理智能体的双视角机制，以及基于显式质量评分的证据剪枝与句子级降噪，有效缓解了多文档问答中“迷失在中间”的位置偏差问题。
en_tdlr: DuQUAD mitigates the Lost-in-the-Middle positional bias in multi-document question answering by combining dual-view reasoning—a Structural Fusion Score-guided Local Agent with a Global Agent—and quality-aware evidence pruning with sentence-level noise refinement.
